# RTINGS.com

> RTINGS.com provides comprehensive product reviews, ratings, and interactive comparison tools across consumer electronics, appliances, and athletic gear.

RTINGS.com specializes in hands-on product testing and detailed comparisons across major categories including televisions, audio equipment, home appliances, and footwear. The site combines expert reviews with interactive tools and calculators to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

## Electronics & Home Appliances Reviews

- [The 6 Best TVs of 2026](https://www.rtings.com/tv/reviews/best/tvs-on-the-market): Best TV reviews featuring Samsung S95F OLED and major brands
- [The 5 Best Cordless Vacuums of 2026](https://www.rtings.com/vacuum/reviews/best/cordless): Cordless vacuum reviews featuring Dyson V15 Detect and alternatives
- [The 4 Best Air Purifiers of 2026](https://www.rtings.com/air-purifier/reviews/best/air-purifiers): Air purifier reviews comparing NuWave OxyPure and Levoit models
- [The 6 Best Air Fryers of 2026](https://www.rtings.com/air-fryer/reviews/best/air-fryers): Best air fryer reviews highlighting Ninja Foodi DZ550 and competitors

## Footwear & Sports Gear Reviews

## Interactive Comparison Tools

- [Comparison Tool: Which Headphones Are Better?](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/tools/compare): Interactive headphone comparison tool for Sony, Apple, Bose, Sennheiser
- [TV Size To Distance Calculator](https://www.rtings.com/tv/reviews/by-size/size-to-distance-relationship): TV size to viewing distance calculator with science-based recommendations
